arxiv-2110-09502.title: Minimum ℓ 1 \ell_{1} -norm interpolators: Precise asymptotics and multiple descent
arxiv-2110-09502.creator: Yue Li, Yuting Wei
arxiv-2110-09502.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yue Li, Yuting Wei. An evolving line of machine learning works observe empirical evidence that suggests interpolating estimators — the ones that achieve zero training error — may not necessarily be harmful. This paper pursues theoretical understanding for an important type of interpolators: the minimum ℓ 1 \ell_{1} -norm interpolator, which is motivated by the observation that several learning algorithms favor low ℓ 1 \ell_{1} -norm solutions in the over-parameterized regime.

arxiv-2303-17143.title: Orientation of Finite Reynolds Number Anisotropic Particles Settling in Turbulence
arxiv-2303-17143.creator: Anubhab Roy, Stefan Kramel, Udayshankar Menon, Greg A. Voth, Donald L. Koch
arxiv-2303-17143.description: Abstract We present experimental and computational results for the orientation distributions of slender fibers and ramified particles settling in an isotropic turbulent flow. The rotational dynamics of the particles is modeled using a slender-body theory that includes the inertial torque due to sedimentation that tends to rotate the particles toward a broadside orientation.

arxiv-2305-04138.title: On the usefulness of linear types for correct nonce use enforcement during compile time
arxiv-2305-04138.creator: Richard Ostertág
arxiv-2305-04138.description: Abstract Cryptographic algorithms and protocols often need unique random numbers as parameters (e.g. nonces). Failure to satisfy this requirement lead to vulnerable implementation and can result in security breach. We show how linear types and static type checking can be used to enforce the correct generation of a new unique random number for each function invocation.

arxiv-2403-17258.title: NS5-brane backgrounds and coset CFT partition functions
arxiv-2403-17258.creator: Andrea Dei and Emil J. Martinec
arxiv-2403-17258.description: Abstract Worldsheet string theory is solvable for a variety of backgrounds involving Neveu-Schwarz fivebranes, in terms of gauged nonlinear sigma models on group manifolds. We compute the worldsheet torus partition function of these models, and propose gauging of null isometries as a unifying principle and conceptual framework for this large family of string backgrounds.

arxiv-2410-01806.title: Samba: Synchronized Set-of-Sequences Modeling for Multiple Object Tracking
arxiv-2410-01806.creator: Mattia Segu, Luigi Piccinelli, Siyuan Li, Yung-Hsu Yang, Bernt Schiele, Luc Van Gool
arxiv-2410-01806.description: Abstract Multiple object tracking in complex scenarios - such as coordinated dance performances, team sports, or dynamic animal groups - presents unique challenges. In these settings, objects frequently move in coordinated patterns, occlude each other, and exhibit long-term dependencies in their trajectories.

BTO is a NASA Student Collaboration Project flying on the Compton Spectrometer and Imager (COSI) Small Explorer mission in 2027.

arxiv-2503-09915.title: Near-Horizon Symmetries of Local Black Holes in General Relativity
arxiv-2503-09915.creator: M M Akbar & S M Modumudi
arxiv-2503-09915.description: Abstract We analyze the near-horizon symmetries of static, axisymmetric, four-dimensional black holes with spherical and toroidal horizon topologies in vacuum general relativity. These black hole solutions, collectively referred to as local/distorted black holes, are known in closed form and are not asymptotically flat.

pmc-10568568.title: Effects of Lactiplantibacillus plantarum on oxidative stress, mitophagy, and NLRP3 inflammasome activation in broiler breast meat
pmc-10568568.creator: Junmeng Yuan, Fan Zhao, Yu Liu, Huawei Liu, Kai Zhang, Xinyu Tian, Yuxin Mu, Jinshan Zhao, Yang Wang
pmc-10568568.description: Poultry meat has a high polyunsaturated fatty acids content, making it vulnerable to oxidative stress. Mitophagy participates in the regulation of oxidative stress and the nucleotide-binding and oligomerization domain (NOD)-like receptor family as well as pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome activation. Lactiplantibacillus plantarum P8 (P8) is a probiotic strain with an antioxidant capacity.

pmc-11494811.creator: Patrizia Tempora, Silvia D’Amico, Paula Gragera, Verena Damiani, Kamila Krol, Valentina Scaldaferri, Kirti Pandey, Shanzou Chung, Valeria Lucarini, Ezio Giorda, Marco Scarsella, Gabriele Volpe, Marco Pezzullo, Cristiano De Stefanis, Valentina D’Oria, Lorenzo De Angelis, Roberto Giovannoni, Maria Ant
pmc-11494811.description: BackgroundCheckpoint immunotherapy unleashes tumor control by T cells, but it is undermined in non-immunogenic tumors, e.g. with low MHC class I expression and low neoantigen burden, such as neuroblastoma (NB). Endoplasmic reticulum aminopeptidase 1 (ERAP1) is an enzyme that trims peptides before loading on MHC class I molecules.

pmc-11510773.title: Presence of Trace Elements in Edible Insects Commercialized through Online E-Commerce Platform
pmc-11510773.creator: Nadia San Onofre, David Vie, Jose M Soriano, Carla Soler, Luis Alberto Henríquez-Hernández
pmc-11510773.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study aimed to evaluate the presence of various elements in edible insect-based food products available for human consumption. Several products were analyzed using atomic spectroscopy, and descriptive statistical analysis was conducted with IBM SPSS Statistics 27. The results revealed the presence of elements such as arsenic, cadmium, copper, magnesium, nickel, silver, lead, tungsten, uranium, mercury, platinum, aluminum, beryllium, bismuth, lithium, antimony, and thallium. Significant differences were found based on product type, insect species, and country of origin.

pmc-11526633.title: The community food environment as an effect modifier of the relationship between racial discrimination and food insecurity among adults in Southern Brazil
pmc-11526633.creator: Emanuele Bottega de Vargas, Mariane da Silva Dias, Ilaine Schuch, Priscila Bárbara Zanini Rosa, Marcos Fanton, Raquel Canuto
pmc-11526633.description: BackgroundRacial discrimination is linked to unhealthy food environments and a higher prevalence of food insecurity. However, no study has explored their interrelated effects. We analyzed the relationship between racial discrimination, community food environment, and food insecurity in adults of different socioeconomic status.

pmc-12469531.title: Brønstead Acid-Catalyzed Regiodivergent Hydroindolation of Indoles: Temperature-Controlled Markovnikov and Anti-Markovnikov Addition
pmc-12469531.creator: Asaithampi Ganesan, Yong-Uk Kwon, Maria G P M S Neves
pmc-12469531.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Brønsted acid-catalyzed, regiodivergent hydroindolation of indoles with terminal aryl alkynes was developed, affording bis(indolyl)alkanes in good to excellent yields. Systematic investigations revealed that temperature variation plays a key role in determining the regioselectivity of anti-Markovnikov and Markovnikov addition reactions. The reaction proceeds efficiently under transition metal-free conditions in an environmentally benign water/alcohol solvent system, using readily available and inexpensive p-toluenesulfonic acid (TsOH) as the catalyst.

pmc-12606545.title: Incidence and risk factors for postoperative vaginal events following radical cystectomy for bladder cancer: a nationwide population‐based study
pmc-12606545.creator: Elin Kalén, Charlotte Ginstman, Fredrik Liedberg, Oskar Hagberg, Martin Holmbom, Tomas Jerlström, Staffan Jahnson, Truls Gårdmark, Viveka Ströck, Lars Holmberg, Christel Häggström, Firas Aljabery
pmc-12606545.description: ObjectiveTo estimate the probability of vaginal events (diagnosis and/or surgery) following radical cystectomy (RC) and explore possible risk factors in a nationwide population‐based observational registry based study.Patients and MethodsWomen undergoing RC for urinary bladder cancer in Sweden, from 1 January 1997 to 31 December 2019, were identified within national registries.

pmc-13213753.title: Dynamics and optimal control of a weighted-network dengue model with seasonal transmission
pmc-13213753.creator: Yantao Luo, Zhidong Teng, Ramziya Rifhat, Lei Wang, Tingting Zheng
pmc-13213753.description: In this paper, we introduce a novel dengue model on a weighted network to investigate the roles of human mobility, seasonal temperature shifts, and spatial heterogeneity. First, the positivity, global existence, and ultimate boundedness of the model solutions have also been discussed.
